class.name: FullBodyIKModifier3D
class.brief_description: Multi-effector FABRIK solver over a bone tree.
class.description: [FullBodyIKModifier3D] solves all [member effectors] together with FABRIK on the bone subtree below [member root_bone] (or the whole skeleton), so effectors that share ancestors pull on the same joints. The root of the subtree is pinned. The solved joint positions are applied as bone rotations on the bones that lead to an effector. Branching bones receive one aim per solved child, so asymmetric poses converge approximately; raise [member iterations] or add more effectors if needed. [member joint_constraints] limits the direction that leaves a bone with a [code]cone[/code] ([code]angle[/code] in radians) or [code]hinge[/code] ([code]axis[/code], [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code] in radians) constraint. Each effector is a dictionary with [code]bone[/code] (name), either [code]target_node[/code] ([NodePath] to a [Node3D]) or [code]target[/code] ([Vector3] in skeleton space), and optional [code]weight[/code].

method.name: add_effector
method.description: Adds an effector that pulls [param bone] towards the [Node3D] at [param target_node].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the largest remaining distance between a fully weighted effector and its target after the last solve.

members.member: Effector dictionaries, see the class description.
